hints.title: Binary Lifting Ancestor Table
hints.text: Precompute table up[node][j] denoting the 2^j-th ancestor of node.

hints.title: Recurrence Relation
hints.text: up[node][j] = up[up[node][j - 1]][j - 1] with base cases up[node][0] = parent[node].

hints.title: Binary Decomposition of K
hints.text: To find the kth ancestor, jump by powers of 2 corresponding to the set bits of k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N log N) precompute, O(log K) query
variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Constructing table takes N * 16 operations, and each query inspects set bits in at most 16 jumps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Stepping one ancestor at a time takes O(K) per query, which reaches O(Q * N) under deep trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing powers of 2 jumps reduces query time from linear to logarithmic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Classic binary lifting table doubling ancestors across bit positions.

solutions.approach: Binary Lifting Powers of Two Table
